figures.title: The complete practical LSS pipeline
figures.alt: The complete practical LSS pipeline. A schematic six-camera rig and illustrated street views become depth-plane evidence, pooled voxel features and a vehicle-logit field. Textured volumes are illustrative, not measured activations. The experimental cost-map branch uses a separate model with the same architecture, not shared trained segmentation weights.
figures.caption: A schematic six-camera rig and illustrated street views become depth-plane evidence, pooled voxel features and a vehicle-logit field. Textured volumes are illustrative, not measured activations. The experimental cost-map branch uses a separate model with the same architecture, not shared trained segmentation weights.

figures.title: Separate camera inputs, geometry and vehicle-mask supervision
figures.alt: Separate camera inputs, geometry and vehicle-mask supervision. Camera normalization and calibration feed the model; the rasterized vehicle target feeds only the objective. Direct resize changes intrinsic rows, whereas augmentation keeps original intrinsics and records its image post-transform. The worked RGB value is illustrative.
figures.caption: Camera normalization and calibration feed the model; the rasterized vehicle target feeds only the objective. Direct resize changes intrinsic rows, whereas augmentation keeps original intrinsics and records its image post-transform. The worked RGB value is illustrative.

figures.title: Shared EfficientNet feature scales and the depth/context projection
figures.alt: Shared EfficientNet feature scales and the depth/context projection. At 128×352 resolution, the illustrated feature pyramid retains a 112-channel stride-16 skip and concatenates it with an upsampled 320-channel feature. Fusion produces 512 channels; projection yields 41 depth logits plus 64 context channels. Cuboid textures and thickness are schematic; shape labels are full practical dimensions.
figures.caption: At 128×352 resolution, the illustrated feature pyramid retains a 112-channel stride-16 skip and concatenates it with an upsampled 320-channel feature. Fusion produces 512 channels; projection yields 41 depth logits plus 64 context channels. Cuboid textures and thickness are schematic; shape labels are full practical dimensions.

figures.title: A worked depth-probability and context outer product
figures.alt: A worked depth-probability and context outer product. At one illustrative pixel, probabilities [0.25,0.75] multiply context [2,−1,4]. The resulting two rows retain all three context channels, and gradients reach both branches. The full lifted tensor is [B,N,D,h,w,C].
figures.caption: At one illustrative pixel, probabilities [0.25,0.75] multiply context [2,−1,4]. The resulting two rows retain all three context channels, and gradients reach both branches. The full lifted tensor is [B,N,D,h,w,C].

figures.title: Frustum pixels unproject to camera coordinates and then ego coordinates
figures.alt: Frustum pixels unproject to camera coordinates and then ego coordinates. With the supplied toy intrinsics, pixel-depth (75,40,4) gives camera XYZ (1,0,4) metres. A 90-degree z rotation and translation (1,2,0) give ego XYZ (1,3,4). Ray planes are schematic, and full depth-bin endpoints are labeled separately.
figures.caption: With the supplied toy intrinsics, pixel-depth (75,40,4) gives camera XYZ (1,0,4) metres. A 90-degree z rotation and translation (1,2,0) give ego XYZ (1,3,4). Ray planes are schematic, and full depth-bin endpoints are labeled separately.

figures.title: Reverse the image post-transform before composing sensor and ego poses
figures.alt: Reverse the image post-transform before composing sensor and ego poses. The illustrated 400×160 toy scene resizes to 200×80, crops to 100×60 and flips horizontally: pixel (50,20) becomes (80,8). This continuous coordinate transform is undone before unprojection. A separate ego-motion illustration shows the camera-time and LiDAR-time pose composition, a documented difference from the original LSS source.
figures.caption: The illustrated 400×160 toy scene resizes to 200×80, crops to 100×60 and flips horizontally: pixel (50,20) becomes (80,8). This continuous coordinate transform is undone before unprojection. A separate ego-motion illustration shows the camera-time and LiDAR-time pose composition, a documented difference from the original LSS source.

figures.title: Half-open voxel masking, floor indices and z-major channel sums
figures.alt: Half-open voxel masking, floor indices and z-major channel sums. The parallel-projected 3-D lattice locates the actual toy points. A and B in cell (0,0,0) add [2,4]+[3,1]=[5,5]; points below the lower bound or at the upper bound are rejected. F at z=1.2 contributes to the second height bin. The four tilted grids show z-major channels, and discrete indices do not carry geometry gradients.
figures.caption: The parallel-projected 3-D lattice locates the actual toy points. A and B in cell (0,0,0) add [2,4]+[3,1]=[5,5]; points below the lower bound or at the upper bound are rejected. F at z=1.2 contributes to the second height bin. The four tilted grids show z-major channels, and discrete indices do not carry geometry gradients.

figures.title: BEV ResNet blocks, long skip, fusion and output head
figures.alt: BEV ResNet blocks, long skip, fusion and output head. The full 200×200 BEV grid becomes 100×100, 50×50 and 25×25 feature grids. The 64-channel skip concatenates with 256 upsampled channels; fusion and a final upsample return raw logits at the original resolution. There is no stem max-pool or internal sigmoid.
figures.caption: The full 200×200 BEV grid becomes 100×100, 50×50 and 25×25 feature grids. The 64-channel skip concatenates with 256 upsampled channels; fusion and a final upsample return raw logits at the original resolution. There is no stem max-pool or internal sigmoid.

figures.title: A complete six-camera full-resolution tensor trace
figures.alt: A complete six-camera full-resolution tensor trace. The value stream [1,6,41,8,22,64] and coordinate stream [1,6,41,8,22,3] share sample axes before voxel reduction. One height bin gives [1,64,200,200], decoded to [1,1,200,200]. This is a shape illustration, not full-resolution parity evidence.
figures.caption: The value stream [1,6,41,8,22,64] and coordinate stream [1,6,41,8,22,3] share sample axes before voxel reduction. One height bin gives [1,64,200,200], decoded to [1,1,200,200]. This is a shape illustration, not full-resolution parity evidence.

figures.title: A worked BCE loss and its mean-reduced logit gradients
figures.alt: A worked BCE loss and its mean-reduced logit gradients. For four zero logits with unit positive weight, the mean BCE is log(2). Two positive targets have gradient −0.125 and two negatives +0.125. Positive-weight and reduction choices matter; no trained loss is reported by this illustration.
figures.caption: For four zero logits with unit positive weight, the mean BCE is log(2). Two positive targets have gradient −0.125 and two negatives +0.125. Positive-weight and reduction choices matter; no trained loss is reported by this illustration.

figures.title: Feature-path backpropagation and a hand-checkable first Adam step
figures.alt: Feature-path backpropagation and a hand-checkable first Adam step. The illustrative positive-label scalar logit has gradient −0.5. Adam with lr=0.1 changes it from 0 to approximately 0.1 and gives loss 0.6444. This scalar example is distinct from the actual lr=0.001 model update executed below.
figures.caption: The illustrative positive-label scalar logit has gradient −0.5. Adam with lr=0.1 changes it from 0 to approximately 0.1 and gives loss 0.6444. This scalar example is distinct from the actual lr=0.001 model update executed below.

figures.title: Decode binary occupancy and aggregate intersection/union
figures.alt: Decode binary occupancy and aggregate intersection/union. The illustrative prediction and target each have three occupied cells, with two shared cells. Their union is four and IoU is 0.5. Full validation sums counts over batches before dividing and reports undefined IoU for an empty aggregate union.
figures.caption: The illustrative prediction and target each have three occupied cells, with two shared cells. Their union is four and IoU is 0.5. Full validation sums counts over batches before dividing and reports undefined IoU for an empty aggregate union.

figures.title: Experimental template paths become negative cost sums and probabilities
figures.alt: Experimental template paths become negative cost sums and probabilities. Two toy trajectories accumulate costs 1 and 5, producing logits −1 and −5 and probabilities about 98.2% and 1.8%. Every point must lie inside the same grid; this example is not a trained or evaluated planning result.
figures.caption: Two toy trajectories accumulate costs 1 and 5, producing logits −1 and −5 and probabilities about 98.2% and 1.8%. Every point must lie inside the same grid; this example is not a trained or evaluated planning result.

figures.title: Explicit real-data, checkpoint and practical-evaluation workflows
figures.alt: Explicit real-data, checkpoint and practical-evaluation workflows. Opt-in paths validate local assets and checkpoint format. Package evaluation reconstructs its model and preprocessing from saved configuration and uses the checkpoint's dataset version. The notebook weight-loading demo is a separate operation; no original-checkpoint compatibility is implied.
